title: Local mode bypasses peer-address blocking
answers: Why are local mode connections being blocked?
Should block_private or block_global apply to local mode?
Why can local mode have a public peer address on macOS?
body:
Symptom: Local mode connections are blocked by the block addon even though local interception should be allowed.
Root cause: mitmproxy/addons/block.py:Block.client_connected classified the peer address without exempting local mode; on macOS, that address may be the interface's public IP.
Fix pattern: Return early for clients whose proxy_mode is mode_specs.LocalMode, before applying private or public address blocking.
Constraints: This exemption applies to local mode regardless of peer-address classification; preserve the existing loopback exemption and address-blocking behavior for other proxy modes.
applies: The block addon's connection checks, especially changes to mode eligibility or peer-address filtering.
